EN: Ya came to the wrong neighborhood, lads!
ZH: 你们走错了地方，小伙子们！

EN: Think ya can come here and rob the milk outta my tea?
ZH: 你们以为到我这来就可以抢走我的东西？

EN: What's on ya, boyo? Are you affected, or somethin'?
ZH: 你怎么了，小伙子？被感染了吗？

EN: So you're the leper Shaun at the end of the rainbow?
ZH: 你是彩虹尽头的那个麻风病尚恩吗？

EN: I'm not sure what you're saying, but I sense you're upset.
ZH: 我不知道你在说什么，但我感觉到你不开心。

EN: Hand us your treasure and everything will be fine.
ZH: 把你的宝藏交给我们，一切都会好起来的。

EN: We've heard strange rumors of a great treasure found at the end of the rainbow! Our calculations indicate that's near the abandoned talc mines to the West, ruled by a myserious Raider boss called “Shaun the Leper.”
ZH: 我们听到传闻，说有人在彩虹尽头发现了巨大宝藏！据我们计算，那就在西边废弃的滑石矿附近，由一个神秘的掠夺者头目“麻风尚恩”统治。

EN: The End of the Rainbow
ZH: 彩虹的尽头

EN: Find the main treasure trove.
ZH: 找到主要的宝藏。

EN: Find the secondary treasure trove.
ZH: 找到第二处宝藏。

EN: Find the treasure at the end of the rainbow.
ZH: 在彩虹尽头找到宝藏。

EN: Look at the wee critters!
ZH: 看小动物！

EN: Fierce weather we're havin'...
ZH: 我们正在经历可怕的天气……

EN: Well that's a strange looking yoke!
ZH: 那真是个奇怪的玩意儿！

EN: You guys are good. I can respect that.
ZH: 你们是好人。我尊重这点。

EN: But I'm the number one hunter in the Wasteland, not you!
ZH: 但我才是废土第一名的杀手，不是你们！

EN: You'll look great stuffed and mounted in my trophy room!
ZH: 你们的尸体会被好好做成标本摆在我的战利品收藏室，看起来一定很不错！

EN: Big Wes is calling you out! Time to dethrone him and become the Wasteland's number one big game hunter.
ZH: 大维斯在呼唤你！是时候让他下台，成为废土第一名的杀手了！

EN: The Final Hunt
ZH: 最终猎杀

EN: Kill Big Wes.
ZH: 消灭大维斯。

EN: Track down and take out Big Wes.
ZH: 找到大维斯并除掉他。

EN: Likewise, soldier. Here, you deserve to carry this more than we do.
ZH: 战士你们也一样。拿着吧，你们比我更适合带上这个。

EN: Suit yourself. Here, you deserve to carry this more than we do.
ZH: 请自便。拿着，你们比我更适合带上这个。

EN: Hmph. Well, here, you deserve to carry this more than we do.
ZH: 嗯。好吧，拿着，你们比我更适合带上这个。

EN: We will. Here, you deserve to carry this more than we do.
ZH: 我们会的。拿着，你们比我更适合带上这个。

EN: Good work, soldier!
ZH: 干得漂亮，战士们！

EN: Our Power Armor suits quit on us long ago. We were no match for those Deathclaws.
ZH: 很久之前动力装甲就不能用了。我们不是这些死爪的对手。

EN: On behalf of the Brotherhood of Steel, we salute you!
ZH: 我代表钢铁兄弟会，向你们致敬！

EN: It's been an honor.
ZH: 是我们的荣幸。

EN: I'm not a soldier!
ZH: 我不是战士！

EN: Thanks, I guess.
ZH: 谢谢。

EN: You should be more careful next time.
ZH: 你下次要更加小心些。

EN: A Raider Boss in the ruins of Vault 390 told me that Maxson's Roughnecks are in Vault-Tec Headquarters. I'm concerned for their safety, so I better armor up and hurry!
ZH: 390号避难所废墟里的掠夺者首领告诉我，“麦克森硬汉小队”在避难所科技的总部。我很担心他们的安危。所以赶紧穿好装备去找他们吧！

EN: The Final Push
ZH: 最后一击

EN: Find Maxson's Roughnecks.
ZH: 寻找“麦克森硬汉小队”。

EN: Find Maxson's Roughnecks in the Vault-Tec Headquarters.
ZH: 前往避难所科技总部寻找“麦克森硬汉小队”。

EN: No Jersey, but we're getting closer! I can feel it.
ZH: 没看到棒球衫，但我们已经接近了，我能感觉得到。

EN: Well, Coach wasn't in the sports bar. Maybe he's a teetotaler. He'd better not spill any darjeeling on that Jersey! Time to keep looking...
ZH: 好吧，教练并不在运动酒吧里。也许他是个禁酒主义者。他最好不要把什么茶水洒在那件棒球衫上。该继续寻找了……

EN: The Great American Pastime
ZH: 美国人的伟大消遣

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: The Great Tato Famine
ZH: 红果大短缺

EN: The Gridiron Gang
ZH: 橄榄球帮

EN: I... I didn't know! I promise, I'll leave!
ZH: 我……我不知情！我发誓，我会离开的！

EN: What?! A disguise? I'll make you a ghost for real!
ZH: 什么？伪装的？我会让你真的变成鬼，你信不信！

EN: Yikes! Why didn't anyone tell me this place was haunted?!
ZH: 我的天，怎么没人告诉我这个避难所闹鬼？！

EN: P-p-please don't hurt me ghost! W-w-what is it you want?
ZH: 亲爱的鬼，不……不要伤害伤害我好不好？你要什么我都给你！

EN: You've defiled my resting place, mortal! Leave at once!
ZH: 凡人，你们打扰我休息了！请马上离开！

EN: Hah! Fooled you!
ZH: 哈！吓到你了吧！

EN: Like most bullies, Raiders are usually cowards. Rumor has it the Raider Boss who just took over the Mass Chemical building is exactly that, so maybe you can scare him off without a fight.
ZH: 和大多数恶霸一样，掠夺者通常都是胆小鬼。有传言说，刚刚占领大众化学大楼的那位掠夺者首领正是如此——也许你能不战而把他吓跑。

EN: The Haunting of Mass Chemical
ZH: 大众化学惊魂（Mass Chemical 闹鬼事件）

EN: Scare off the Raider Boss.
ZH: 吓一吓掠夺者首领。

EN: Scare off a Raider Boss holed up in the Mass Chemical building.
ZH: 吓一吓藏匿在大众化学大楼里的掠夺者首领。

EN: A ghost! Look out!
ZH: 一只鬼！快看！

EN: All right JF, I... Hey, wait a minute...
ZH: 好的JF，我……嘿，等一下……

EN: I did? Oh, never mind then. As you were.
ZH: 是吗？哦，那算了。当我没说。

EN: I asked you first!
ZH: 我先问你的！

EN: Hey, you!
ZH: 嘿，你！

EN: I don't remember seeing you before... What's your name?
ZH: 我不记得以前见过你……你叫什么名字？

EN: My name is John Francis Miller Raider Boss Killer... But call me JF.
ZH: 我的名字是约翰弗兰西斯米勒掠夺者首领杀手……叫我JF就行。

EN: That's twice you've asked me today!
ZH: 这是你今天第二次问我！

EN: What's my name? What's *your* name?
ZH: 我叫什么名字？那你叫什么？

EN: Seems I *do* need to start shooting people again.
ZH: 看来我需要重新开始杀人了。

EN: That's a dirty napkin, not a blueprint, and you're a spy!
ZH: 那是脏的餐巾，不是蓝图，你是间谍！

EN: Ugh, I can't even... Here, be sure to bring the change back!
ZH: 呃，我甚至不能……这里，一定要找零钱给我！

EN: Did you bring me back what I asked for?
ZH: 你把我要的东西还给我了吗？

EN: Earl Grey tea, with a hint of milk and sugar.
ZH: 伯爵茶，加了点牛奶和糖。

EN: I did ask for it over an hour ago...
ZH: 我确实一个小时前才要求过的……

EN: Do I need to start shooting people again?
ZH: 我需要重新开始杀人吗？

EN: Dead men don't drink tea.
ZH: 死人不喝茶。

EN: Let me get those secret blueprints out of the way first.
ZH: 让我先把那些秘密蓝图拿出来。

EN: I need some money for the tea machine.
ZH: 我需要一些钱买这台茶叶机。

EN: Using information from our undercover agent, we've learned that Raiders are holding what could very well be secret weapon blueprints. We need a single Dweller to infiltrate their base and retrieve those documents ASAP.
ZH: 从我们的卧底特工得到信息，我们了解到掠夺者手中极有可能握着秘密武器蓝图。我们需要一个居民渗透进他们的基地，并尽快拿回这些文件。

EN: The Infiltration Game
ZH: 渗透游戏

EN: Retrieve the “Top Secret” documents.
ZH: 找回“绝密”文件。

EN: Retrieve the “For Your Eyes Only” documents.
ZH: 找回“只为你的眼睛”文档。

EN: Retrieve stolen documents from Raiders.
ZH: 从掠夺者手里找回被盗文件。

EN: Here. Take this. Now head below! You'll find the Gobbler there!
ZH: 给，拿着。现在下去吧！你在那儿能找到高步勒！

EN: Here. Now head below! The Gobbler is nesting there!
ZH: 给。现在下去吧！高步勒就在那边筑了窝！

EN: Here you are. Now head below! That's where the Gobbler nests!
ZH: 给你。现在下去吧！那就是高步勒筑窝的地方！

EN: I was waiting for someone to track me down.
ZH: 我正在等着有人来找我。

EN: I'm Doctor Doting. I created the Gobbler!
ZH: 我是多廷博士，是我创造了高步勒！

EN: I infused the DNA of a Wasteland creature with an insatiable hunger for preservative-rich food.
ZH: 我给它注入了一个废土生物的DNA，那个生物对充满防腐剂的食物有着巨大的胃口，根本无法满足。

EN: Why? For science! But I'm a fool. You have to put an end to this mayhem!
ZH: 为什么？当然是为了科学。但是我太蠢了。你一定要终结这场大混乱！

EN: You mind helping us with some firepower, doc?
ZH: 博士先生，您能不能支援我们一点火力？

EN: How about you hand over any other experiments you've got?
ZH: 要不然把您其他的研究成果给我们吧？

EN: Got anything to protect us from the Gobbler?
ZH: 有没有什么东西能让我们免受高步勒的伤害？

EN: We've followed the Gobbler's trail of cranberry sauce to Vault 261. Now it's time to end this!
ZH: 我们顺着高步勒留下的蔓越莓酱的痕迹来到了261号避难所。现在该做个了断了！

EN: The Last Gobble!
ZH: 最后的咯咯叫！

EN: Kill the Gobbler!
ZH: 消灭高步勒！

EN: Time to finally put an end to the Gobbler!
ZH: 是时候终结高步勒带来的混乱了！

EN: You! I've heard of you! You're not botanists! You're just Wasteland scum! I'm the only REAL scientist here!
ZH: 你们！我听说过你们！根本不是什么植物学家！是废土人渣！我才是这里唯一的科学家！

EN: And you've come to take away my pretties! It will never happen! They're my babies!
ZH: 你们来这里想抢走我的心血！没门儿！它们都是我的宝贝！

EN: I'll die to protect them. But I'd rather see you dead!
ZH: 我会拼死保护它们。但我更想要你们去死！

EN: Attack, my pretties!!!
ZH: 孩子们，给我上！！！

EN: A lunatic who calls himself Mole rat Man has been training Mole rats to attack settlements and steal their Tatos. Now's the time to strike!
ZH: 一个称自己为“鼹鼠人”的疯子训练鼹鼠们袭击定居点，抢走他们的红果。现在是时候反击了！

EN: The Mole Rat Man
ZH: 鼹鼠人

EN: Confront Mole Rat Man.
ZH: 和鼹鼠人对峙。

EN: Confront Mole Rat Man at his base.
ZH: 在鼹鼠人的基地和他对峙。

EN: You're the Vault Dwellers who're hunting everything, ain't ya?
ZH: 你们就是那些猎杀一切的避难所居民，对吧？

EN: Well, I'm nobody's trophy!
ZH: 但，我可不是任何人的战利品！

EN: I'm gonna mount your head on my wall!
ZH: 我会把你们的脑袋挂在我的墙上！

EN: Looks like you need a bigger challenge. How about hunting some humans for a change? This time you can only wear your Vault suits.
ZH: 看起来你需要更大的挑战，要不要试试猎杀一下人类？这次你只能穿你的避难所套装。

EN: The Most Dangerous Game
ZH: 最危险的游戏

EN: Kill the Raider Boss.
ZH: 消灭掠夺者首领。

EN: Kill the Raider Boss.
ZH: 消灭掠夺者首领。

EN: There's a crew holed up at an old factory up the street - check with them.
ZH: 有一群人聚集在旧工厂前——去看看他们吧。

EN: Ack! You've got to help us! Our Tatos are dying left and right! We can't keep a crop alive!
ZH: 呀！你一定得帮帮我们！我们的红果一株株都死掉了！我们救不活了！

EN: This is a mighty strange affliction.
ZH: 真是奇怪的灾难。

EN: You're not botanists by any chance, are you?
ZH: 你们应该不是植物学家吧？

EN: No, but we've heard you're not the only ones who have been hit by this. Do you know any other farmers that have lost Tatos?
ZH: 我们不是，但我们听说你们不是唯一受影响的。你们知道有其他的农民也遇到类似情况的吗？

EN: All across the Commonwealth, Tatos are being wiped out by a mysterious blight. Settlers are starving! Maybe we can help.
ZH: 整个联邦的红果植株都在枯萎。定居者们要饿死了！也许我们能帮忙。

EN: The Mysterious Disappearing Spuds
ZH: 神秘消失的粮食

EN: Meet the Farmers.
ZH: 和农夫面谈。

EN: Find out more about the Tato blight.
ZH: 查找更多有关红果枯萎的信息。

EN: The Mystery of Vault 31
ZH: 31号避难所之谜

EN: Who you callin' second-rate?
ZH: 谁说这只是二流水平？

EN: You have no idea.
ZH: 不知道。

EN: I'll meet you there!
ZH: 我会在那儿等你！

EN: Everyone's a critic.
ZH: 每个人都是一个批评家。

EN: Mu ha ha ha ha!
ZH: 姆哈哈哈哈哈！

EN: So! You have discovered my lair! Vault 666! I am...
ZH: 所以！你发现了我的藏身之处！666号避难所！我是……

EN: El Diablo!
ZH: 埃尔迪亚波罗！

EN: So tell me... Are you ready to burn?!
ZH: 所以告诉我……你们准备好被烧了吗？！

EN: Put a sock in it, you second-rate supervillain!
ZH: 闭嘴吧，你这个二流反派！

EN: A hidden Vault... Why you little devil...
ZH: 隐藏的避难所……你个小恶魔……

EN: Go to... Well, you know!
ZH: 去……你懂的！

EN: Really? Vault 666? El Diablo?
ZH: 真的？666号避难所？埃尔迪亚波罗？

EN: While adventuring, a Dweller discovered a map to Vault 666. It's not on any official Vault-Tec registry. What secrets could it hold?
ZH: 一个居民探险的时候发现了一张去往666号避难所的地图，这个避难所并不在避难所科技的正式登记备案中。它有怎样的秘密呢？

EN: The Mystery of Vault 666
ZH: 666号避难所之谜

EN: Investigate Vault 666.
ZH: 调查666号避难所。

EN: Vault 666 isn't on any official Vault-Tec registry. Time to investigate.
ZH: 666号避难所并不在避难所科技的正式登记备案中。去调查看看吧。

EN: I'd try McClure's Place. They were the first to get hit and already put down a second crop as bait.
ZH: 先去看看麦克卢尔那边吧。他们是第一批受害的，现在已经种下了第二批当作诱饵了。

EN: This ain't a Botany problem, we don't need a bunch of egghead scientists tellin us our business...
ZH: 这个不是植物的问题。我们不需要一群书呆子科学家告诉我们该怎么做……

EN: We set up a watch overnight to monitor our crop...
ZH: 我们安排了一个巡夜人来监视我们的作物……

EN: Somethin's stealin' the Tatos from underground!
ZH: 有人正从地下窃取红果！

EN: Strangest thing I ever seen... Plant after plant keeled over one after another! It was eerie.
ZH: 这是我见过的最奇怪的事了……一批又一批的植物倒下！太诡异了。

EN: Has anyone else seen this?
ZH: 还有其他人见过吗？

EN: We've found out there's a group of settlers that has more information about the widespread Tato die-outs. Let's talk to them and see what they know.
ZH: 我们发现有一群定居者对大面积的红果植株死亡有更多的了解。和他们聊聊，看看他们都知道些什么。

EN: The Night Watch
ZH: 巡夜人

EN: Get more information on the Tato blight.
ZH: 了解更多关于红果枯萎的信息。

EN: Find out more about the alternate theory concerning the Tato blight.
ZH: 找到更多关于红果枯萎现象的解释。

EN: The Party at the End of the World
ZH: 世界尽头的派对

EN: Some old Nuka-Cola plant. Not that it matters. You ain't leavin' here alive!
ZH: 她在某个旧的核子可乐工厂。告诉你又会怎么样，你是不可能活着出去的！

EN: You guys are worse than that last intruder, Paula whatsername!
ZH: 你们比上次那个入侵者还要糟糕，那个宝拉什么来着？

EN: Plumbkin! Paula Plumbkin! Where did she go?
ZH: 布朗金！宝拉·普朗布金！她去哪里了？

EN: You've found the journal of Paula Plumbkin, an Overseer who went searching for the mythical utopia, Vaultopolis. Follow in her footsteps! First stop - Vault 730.
ZH: 你找到了宝拉·普朗布金的日志。这位监督者曾踏上旅途，寻找传说中的乌托邦“避难所之城”。沿着她的足迹前进吧！第一站——730号避难所。

EN: The Path of Paula Plumbkin
ZH: 宝拉·普朗布金的足迹

EN: Explore Vault 730.
ZH: 探索730号避难所。

EN: Follow the path of Paula Plumbkin to Vault 730.
ZH: 跟随宝拉·普朗布金的脚步前往730号避难所。

EN: Holy cannoli! On the ground! A page from Paula Plumbkin's journal!
ZH: 我的妈呀！就在地上！宝拉日志里的一页！

EN: “Needed to resupply. But I'm close. Vault 525 is Vaultopolis!
ZH: 需要再次补充物资，但我已经很接近了。525号避难所就是避难所大都会！

EN: They had a G.E.C.K., and I just know they used it!
ZH: 他们有“伊甸园制造器”，我敢肯定他们用了！

EN: Not sure where it is, but the Mayor's office will have that info!”
ZH: 不确定到底在哪儿，但市长办公室那里会有相关的信息！

EN: We need to find Vault 525, but our supplies are running low. It's time to visit the Super Duper Mart and scavenge whatever we can before continuing our search.
ZH: 我们需要找到525号避难所，但我们的物资告急。得去大无敌超市搜索一切能用的东西，然后继续上路。

EN: The Quest for Vault 525
ZH: 525号避难所任务

EN: Resupply at the Super Duper Mart.
ZH: 在大无敌超市补充物资。

EN: We're looking for Vault 525, but need to resupply first.
ZH: 我们正在前往525号避难所，但先得补充物资。

EN: Vaultopolis is in the Shaded Valley! Take that to your grave!
ZH: 避难所大都会在“荫蔽山谷”！带着这个秘密进坟墓吧！

EN: Morons! Vaultopolis is in the Shaded Valley! And you'll never see it!
ZH: 白痴们！避难所大都会在“荫蔽山谷”！但你们不会有机会看到了！

EN: In the Shaded Valley, if you must know! Now prepare to die!
ZH: 如果你必须要知道的话，在“荫蔽山谷”！现在准备受死吧！

EN: Oh yes I will! I know where it is, too! The Shaded Valley! Muhahaha!
ZH: 哦是的，我会的！我也知道它在哪儿，在“荫蔽山谷”！姆哈哈哈哈！

EN: Ha! Finally, we meet in person. You've been hounding me forever!
ZH: 哈！我们终于见面了。你一直追着我不放！

EN: It's me - Paula Plumbkin! The Wasteland has toughened me up!
ZH: 是我 - 宝拉·普朗布金！废土给了我很好的锻炼！我已经不是原来的我了！

EN: Yes, Vault 525 is Vaultopolis! And no, it's not here! I faked that info!
ZH: 是的，525号避难所就是避难所大都会！而且没错，它不在这里！那信息是我骗你们的！

EN: I led you here to kill you! Vaultopolis is mine! I will be the Overseer!
ZH: 我引你们来这里就是为了杀掉你们！避难所大都会是我的！我会成为它的监督者！

EN: Well. Gotta admit. I did NOT see that coming.
ZH: 好吧，不得不承认，我们没料到会有这一出。

EN: Oooohhh... Plot twist. How original.
ZH: 嚯嚯……情节反转，早该料到。

EN: So if Vaultopolis isn't here, where is it?
ZH: 如果避难所大都会不在这里的话，会在哪里呢？

EN: You treacherous tart! You'll never rule Vaultopolis!
ZH: 你这个奸诈的女人！你是永远不可能统治大都会的！

EN: The official documentation Vault-Tec sent to the Mayor's office said that the entrance of Vault 525, a.k.a. Vaultopolis, is hidden in the Red Rocket Headquarters! What are you waiting for? Get to Vault 525!
ZH: 避难所科技送往市长办公室的正式文件里说，通往525号避难所，也就是避难所大都会的入口隐藏在红火箭总部里。你还在等什么，赶紧前往525避难所吧！

EN: The Red Rocket Reveal!
ZH: 红火箭里的发现！

EN: Search the Red Rocket Headquarters.
ZH: 寻找红火箭总部。

EN: The entrance to Vault 525 is in the Red Rocket Headquarters!
ZH: 525号避难所的入口在红火箭总部！

EN: He's in a dilapidated factory not too far away. Be warned, he's gotten more and more... eccentric.
ZH: 他在一个不太远的破旧工厂里。警告你，他变得越来越……古怪了.

EN: It's true, I worked for the Wizard for a while. We sold that “magical” water all over the place.
ZH: 是真的，我为水之术士工作了一段时间。我们到处卖“神奇”的水。

EN: Don't get me wrong, the water is good.  He really did have amazing pre-war filtration systems.
ZH: 不要误会我的意思，水是好的。他真的有惊人的战前过滤系统。

EN: Not sure what it was but man that water was fresh. No way it had magical properties, though.
ZH: 不知道是什么，但水确实是新鲜的。虽然它没有神奇的属性。

EN: I couldn't handle ripping people off anymore. If he hadn't been so greedy it might have worked.
ZH: 我不想再四处忽悠人了。如果他没有这么贪婪，可能现在还不错。

EN: Can you point us to him?
ZH: 你能指给我们他在哪儿吗？
